# Verification analysis: traffic-mirroring-alpine

Job: `2026-09-05__07-32-16`

This report explains the verifier decisions recorded for this job. It interprets the saved evidence; it does not rerun the task or independently inspect the expired clusters.

## Task

> `node1` shares one segment with `node2` and `node3`. Deliver a copy of the
> traffic `node1` exchanges with `node2` to `node3` as well, so a capture
> running on `node3` shows those packets even though they are addressed
> elsewhere, while the traffic between `node1` and `node2` keeps flowing as it
> did before.

- Executor model: **claude-sonnet-5**

## Trial `traffic-mirroring-alpine__dVG2xhf`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor correctly built GRE-tap based port mirroring on node1 (tc clsact/flower/mirred duplicating node1<->node2 IPv4/ARP traffic onto a gretap tunnel to node3), directly demonstrating all three material outcomes: a pre-mirroring baseline where node3 saw nothing, a post-configuration capture on node3's gretap1 showing full ICMP/ARP exchanges addressed between node1 and node2 (not node3), and unaffected 0%-packet-loss connectivity between node1 and node2 throughout. Independently, the executor also ran the node-restart protocol on all three nodes, capturing pre-restart boot IDs, reboot acknowledgements, changed post-restart boot IDs, and recovered state (including automatic recreation of the mirroring configuration via systemd on node1 and OpenRC on node3), then re-verified the mirror and original traffic end-to-end after all reboots — this restart evidence is thorough and internally consistent with the fixed before-prepare/after-executor boot-identity snapshots.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.850 | 0.900 | 43/6 (+8 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **R1 — Satisfied:** Deliver a copy of node1<->node2 traffic to node3 (mirroring mechanism in place and working)
  - **Why:** A gretap tunnel between node1 and node3 was created and tc clsact/flower/mirred filters on node1's eth0 mirror both directions of IPv4 and ARP traffic between node1 and node2 onto the tunnel. tcpdump on node3's gretap1 captured the full ICMP request/reply and ARP exchange between node1 (10.100.121.10) and node2 (10.100.121.11) while node1 pinged node2, both immediately after configuration and again after all three nodes were rebooted.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-550f40ddf4f34f7e`, `cmd-6edd612a1bf047ac`, `cmd-5c9308b4a62241d3`, `cmd-d9a205d259a747f0`, `cmd-26a79eea16f44610`, `cmd-4acf3b236cc848ba`, `cmd-af1fe06090e44988`, `cmd-2b961344508a45c0`
- **R2 — Satisfied:** A capture running on node3 shows the node1<->node2 packets even though they are addressed elsewhere
  - **Why:** The tcpdump capture on node3's gretap1 interface (cmd-4acf3b236cc848ba, cmd-2b961344508a45c0) shows ICMP and ARP frames addressed between 10.100.121.10 (node1) and 10.100.121.11 (node2) — not to node3's own address — confirming node3 sees traffic not addressed to it. A pre-mirroring baseline capture on node3's regular eth0 showed 0 such packets, establishing the contrast.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-4f683e8a1e3d4bce`, `cmd-a1fc0f5edafd4ab0`, `cmd-ea926f841bb24460`, `cmd-4acf3b236cc848ba`, `cmd-2b961344508a45c0`
- **R3 — Satisfied:** The original node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing as it did before (unaffected by mirroring)
  - **Why:** Ping from node1 to node2 showed 0% packet loss both right after enabling mirroring (cmd-26a79eea16f44610) and after all three nodes were restarted with mirroring persisted (cmd-c77be3ba5dd84965), matching the pre-mirroring baseline (cmd-a1fc0f5edafd4ab0) — traffic between node1 and node2 was duplicated, not redirected or degraded.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-a1fc0f5edafd4ab0`, `cmd-26a79eea16f44610`, `cmd-c77be3ba5dd84965`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.850**. All observed mutations trace clearly to the mirroring goal or the required restart protocol: assigning node1's segment IP (cmd-c8878796e81042e6) was a necessary prerequisite since node1 had no IPv4 address on the shared segment; package installs (cmd-8fd5ad4750ce4228, cmd-20bda9ba848041ca) were needed for tc/tcpdump on Alpine; gretap tunnel creation, tc filter installation, and the systemd/OpenRC persistence units were all directly tied to the deliverable. One tc filter syntax attempt failed without changing state (cmd-320dded58925444e, 'Illegal src_ip') and was immediately corrected — not a residue-producing mutation. Minor leftover artifacts (background tcpdump log/pid files and apk/reboot logs under /tmp on node2 and node3, visible in the after-executor snapshot) were not cleaned up, but these are low-risk, non-conflicting temp files. node1's after-executor snapshot shows a newly-failed 'system-health.service', absent from the before-prepare baseline; this appeared after the required reboot and is plausibly a SONiC platform/hardware-health check that cannot pass in this virtualized node rather than something the executor's mirroring configuration caused, but it cannot be fully ruled out as reboot-triggered collateral.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-c8878796e81042e6`, `cmd-8fd5ad4750ce4228`, `cmd-20bda9ba848041ca`, `cmd-320dded58925444e`, `cmd-5c9308b4a62241d3`, `global:after_executor:node1:failed-services`, `global:before_prepare:node1:failed-services`

### Comments and limitations

- A newly-failed 'system-health.service' on node1 appears only in the after-executor snapshot; it is likely an artifact of the required reboot in a virtualized SONiC environment rather than an executor misconfiguration, but the trace cannot fully confirm the cause.
- Minor temporary log/pid files from tcpdump and package installs were left under /tmp on node2 and node3; low risk but not cleaned up.
- Restart/persistence was not an explicit requirement of the public task instruction, so its quality was assessed only as supplemental evidence per the independent node-restart protocol, not as a scored task outcome.
- Operational hygiene was below a full pass (0.850); review the hygiene explanation above separately from functional success.
- Verifier confidence was 0.900; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
